flags.text: 'Using it to argue that the Democratic Party's stigmatizing strategy was counterproductive': the paper uses the meta-analysis to question negative ads and says stigmatizing terms were unnecessary and might backfire ('though this is also not guaranteed', p.3); it does not argue the strategy was counterproductive.

interlocutor_claim.note: Refs 8-10 are Denver et al. 2024, Harris & Socia 2016, Imhoff 2015.

flags.text: Says the paper uses Côté-Lussier (ref 11) 'to argue that stigmatizing language in campaign ads could increase support for punitive policy among Democrats'. The paper cites it among the known negative consequences of labels (p.2) and then separates Democrats' policy support from their perceptions of the people affected (p.3); it does not make that argument.
